issue: देवी देव दयनीय दशा में दया दया तव नाम — read as 'to goddesses and gods in a pitiable plight, your name is mercy, mercy'; देवी may be an address ('O Goddess, the gods in a pitiable plight …') or the gods may be crying 'mercy, mercy' and your name.
our reading: To goddesses and gods in a pitiable plight, your name is mercy, mercy.
alternatives: O Goddess, the gods in a pitiable plight (cry) mercy, mercy, and your name
